attachments.title: Neurovalens Unveils Modius SLEEP, a Next-Gen Device Powered by Neuroscience to Optimize Sleep Health #Sleep #Modius
attachments.text:
Global HealthTech company Neurovalens today launched Modius SLEEP, a drug-free solution powered by neuroscience to safely and non-invasively improve a person’s sleep health.
Modius SLEEP is a headset, worn for 30 minutes before bed. Unlike other sleep headsets that are limited to passively reading brain-wave activity, Modius SLEEP actively stimulates the key sleep neurons in the brain reducing the time it takes to fall asleep and keeping you asleep for longer.
The device works by sending a safe electrical pulse into the vestibular nerve, influencing the areas of the hypothalamus and brain stem that control circadian rhythm and sleep patterns.
Modius SLEEP has launched on American crowd-funding website Indiegogo, following the success of Modius SLIM, the company’s first headset, designed to help people lose weight, which raised £2million on the same platform.


Developed by neuroscientist Dr. Jason McKeown, a Northern Ireland native, the latest product innovation continues the company’s mission to improve global health and wellness by providing drug-free, neurological solutions for common health problems.
Dr. Jason McKeown, Founder and CEO of Neurovalens, said:
“After gathering feedback from thousands of SLIM device users around the world, what we found was that improved sleep was a welcomed bonus reaction and this became our motivation for making specific changes to our technology to create Modius SLEEP.
“Our new headset taps into the power of the brain’s hypothalamus, which acts as a mini computer and influences many areas of the brain, including weight loss and sleep. Our continued aim is to help people avoid sedatives and sleeping pills as they only mask the underlying problem and come with a host of nasty side effects.
“We use neuroscience to improve lives through safe, innovative, non-invasive products and we have complete confidence our SLEEP device is just as life changing as our SLIM device continues to be.”

In an initial 30-day study, 95% of Modius SLEEP users improved their overall sleep score with 85% claiming that they were more satisfied with their sleep patterns. Additionally, 71.3% of survey respondents with sleep issues reported positive changes when using Modius SLEEP.
Neurovalens has launched its Modius SLEEP campaign on Indiegogo. For the duration of the fundraising campaign, the product is available from $249 on Indiegogo and will eventually retail for £399 in the UK and Ireland.
